comment: Per-app compatibility rules shared by every shell. Keys are bundle identifiers; 'prefixes' match bundle-ID prefixes. Fields: disabled (no suggestions by default), agent_prompt_only (terminals: suggest only on an AI-agent prompt line), insertion ('keystrokes' | 'paste' | 'paste-long' | 'first-word-then-paste'), prime ('chromium' | 'electron'), caret ('pixel': always find the caret from screen pixels because the app's accessibility geometry is wrong; 'ax': never; unset: accessibility, falling back to pixels when it gives nothing), note. 'agent_prompt' lists the line markers of CLI agent prompts (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode): an optional border character, then a marker, then the prompt text.

com.apple.Terminal.note: Terminal: suggestions only on AI-agent prompts (Claude Code, Codex, ...).

com.googlecode.iterm2.note: Terminal: suggestions only on AI-agent prompts (Claude Code, Codex, ...).

com.github.wez.wezterm.note: Terminal: suggestions only on AI-agent prompts (Claude Code, Codex, ...).

io.alacritty.note: Terminal: suggestions only on AI-agent prompts (Claude Code, Codex, ...).

com.microsoft.VSCode.note: Code editor; main buffer off by default. Chat inputs on (allow_fields; "Message input" checked in VS Code on 2026-10-21).

com.todesktop.230313mzl4w4u92.note: Cursor; code editor. Chat/composer inputs on (allow_fields; patterns unverified).

com.exafunction.windsurf.note: Windsurf; code editor. Cascade/chat inputs on (allow_fields; patterns unverified).

dev.zed.Zed.note: Draws its own text; no AX text.

company.thebrowser.Browser.note: Arc: needs chrome://accessibility Text Metrics for inline caret.

com.microsoft.teams2.note: Teams (WebView2): builds its tree only on AXEnhancedUserInterface, AXManualAccessibility is unsupported (checked 2026-10-28). Returns empty caret rects; the pixel caret locator is the fallback.

org.libreoffice.script.note: LibreOffice: one AX element per paragraph; the zero-length caret rect is a sentinel and paragraph frames are about 100 pt above the text, while character rects are right. The pixel caret confirms the character rects, then they are used; reports the unzoomed font size.

com.apple.TextEdit.note: TextKit: zero-length caret rect is one line high; marked range always present (zero length).

com.apple.Safari.note: Address bar is an AXTextField; caret rect one line high.

com.microsoft.Word.note: Reports a fake font name; family wins.

com.microsoft.Excel.note: Spreadsheet cells: Tab must move between cells.

org.mozilla.firefox.note: No caret geometry; expect mirror card.

app.zen-browser.zen.note: No caret geometry; expect mirror card.

com.obsproject.obs-studio.note: OBS: its own text fields are Qt and need no priming; browser docks run in CEF (Chromium) and are unchecked.

com.openai.codex.note: ChatGPT/Codex app (installed as ChatGPT.app), on OpenAI's 'owl' Chromium runtime: AXManualAccessibility is unsupported, AXEnhancedUserInterface builds the tree (checked 2026-10-27, version 26.1021).
